sanskrit: yaṁ rakṣa̍nti̱ prace̍taso̱ varu̍ṇo mi̱tro a̍rya̱mā | nū ci̱t sa da̍bhyate̱ jana̍ḥ ||
english: The man whom the far-sighted ones protect — Varuṇa, Mitra, and Aryamā — that man can never be deceived.

sanskrit: yam bā̱hute̍va̱ pipra̍ti̱ pānti̱ martya̍ṁ ri̱ṣaḥ | ari̍ṣṭa̱ḥ sarva̍ edhate ||
english: They guard the mortal man from harm as if with arms upraised; unscathed in every way he prospers.

sanskrit: vi du̱rgā vi dviṣa̍ḥ pu̱ro ghnanti̱ rājā̍na eṣām | naya̍nti duri̱tā ti̱raḥ ||
english: The kings of these — those sovereign lords — break down the foes' strongholds and lead them safely through all difficulties.

sanskrit: su̱gaḥ panthā̍ anṛkṣa̱ra ādi̍tyāsa ṛ̱taṁ ya̱te | nātrā̍vakhā̱do a̍sti vaḥ ||
english: Easy and thornless is the path, O Ādityas, for him who walks by ṛta; there is no stumbling-block for you there.

sanskrit: yaṁ ya̱jñaṁ naya̍thā nara̱ ādi̍tyā ṛ̱junā̍ pa̱thā | pra va̱ḥ sa dhī̱taye̍ naśat ||
english: The sacrifice that you, O lords, O Ādityas, lead along the straight path — may it reach forward unto your contemplation.

sanskrit: sa ratna̱m martyo̱ vasu̱ viśva̍ṁ to̱kam u̱ta tmanā̍ | acchā̍ gaccha̱ty astṛ̍taḥ ||
english: That mortal, unassailed, moves toward the jewel, toward all wealth, toward offspring, and himself goes forward.

sanskrit: ka̱thā rā̍dhāma sakhāya̱ḥ stoma̍m mi̱trasyā̍rya̱mṇaḥ | mahi̱ psaro̱ varu̍ṇasya ||
english: How, O friends, shall we worthily achieve the hymn of Mitra and Aryamā, and the great magnificence of Varuṇa?

sanskrit: mā vo̱ ghnanta̱m mā śapa̍nta̱m prati̍ voce deva̱yanta̍m | su̱mnair id va̱ ā vi̍vāse ||
english: May I not speak back to you — who smite and who curse — when I am seeking the gods; with your gracious favors alone do I desire to win you.

sanskrit: ca̱tura̍ś ci̱d dada̍mānād bibhī̱yād ā nidhā̍toḥ | na du̍ru̱ktāya̍ spṛhayet ||
english: Even a generous giver should fear up to the moment of deposit; let him not covet evil speech.

sanskrit: sam pū̍ṣa̱nn adhva̍nas tira̱ vy aṁho̍ vimuco napāt | sakṣvā̍ deva̱ pra ṇa̍s pu̱raḥ ||
english: O Pūṣan, cross us safely over the road; O offspring of the Deliverer, drive away adversity; lead us forward, O god.

sanskrit: yo na̍ḥ pūṣann a̱gho vṛko̍ du̱ḥśeva̍ ā̱dide̍śati | apa̍ sma̱ tam pa̱tho ja̍hi ||
english: The evil wolf, O Pūṣan, that ill-omened one who menaces us — drive him away from the road.

sanskrit: apa̱ tyam pa̍ripa̱nthina̍m muṣī̱vāṇa̍ṁ hura̱ścita̍m | dū̱ram adhi̍ sru̱ter a̍ja ||
english: Drive far away that lurking robber, the ambusher who lies crooked in the path, away from the track.

sanskrit: tvaṁ tasya̍ dvayā̱vino̱ 'ghaśa̍ṁsasya̱ kasya̍ cit | pa̱dābhi ti̍ṣṭha̱ tapu̍ṣim ||
english: Tread down with your foot the burning force of that double-tongued one, whosoever he may be who utters evil.

sanskrit: ā tat te̍ dasra mantuma̱ḥ pūṣa̱nn avo̍ vṛṇīmahe | yena̍ pi̱tṝn aco̍dayaḥ ||
english: That aid of yours, O wondrous Pūṣan, we choose by our prayer — that with which you once urged forward the Fathers.

sanskrit: adhā̍ no viśvasaubhaga̱ hira̍ṇyavāśīmattama | dhanā̍ni su̱ṣaṇā̍ kṛdhi ||
english: So now, O lord of all good fortune, you who possess the finest golden axe, make our riches easy to win.

sanskrit: ati̍ naḥ sa̱ścato̍ naya su̱gā na̍ḥ su̱pathā̍ kṛṇu | pūṣa̍nn i̱ha kratu̍ṁ vidaḥ ||
english: Lead us past those who follow after us; make the roads good and the paths easy for us; O Pūṣan, find the resolve for us here.

sanskrit: a̱bhi sū̱yava̍saṁ naya̱ na na̍vajvā̱ro adhva̍ne | pūṣa̍nn i̱ha kratu̍ṁ vidaḥ ||
english: Lead us to good pasture; let there be no fresh sting of distress upon the road; O Pūṣan, find the resolve for us here.

sanskrit: śa̱gdhi pū̱rdhi pra ya̍ṁsi ca śiśī̱hi prāsy u̱dara̍m | pūṣa̍nn i̱ha kratu̍ṁ vidaḥ ||
english: Strengthen us, fill us, send us forth, and whet our front; O Pūṣan, find the resolve for us here.

sanskrit: na pū̱ṣaṇa̍m methāmasi sū̱ktair a̱bhi gṛ̍ṇīmasi | vasū̍ni da̱smam ī̍mahe ||
english: We do not contend against Pūṣan; we praise him with hymns well-spoken; we implore the wondrous one for wealth.

sanskrit: kad ru̱drāya̱ prace̍tase mī̱ḻhuṣṭa̍māya̱ tavya̍se | vo̱cema̱ śaṁta̍maṁ hṛ̱de ||
english: What most heartening word shall we speak to the far-seeing Rudra, the most bounteous, the mighty one?

sanskrit: yathā̍ no̱ adi̍ti̱ḥ kara̱t paśve̱ nṛbhyo̱ yathā̱ gave̍ | yathā̍ to̱kāya̍ ru̱driya̍m ||
english: As Aditi has brought it about for our cattle, for our men, for our cows — so may the Rudrian grace be ours for our offspring.

sanskrit: yathā̍ no mi̱tro varu̍ṇo̱ yathā̍ ru̱draś cike̍tati | yathā̱ viśve̍ sa̱joṣa̍saḥ ||
english: As Mitra and Varuṇa know it for us, as Rudra discerns it, as all the gods who share one pleasure know it.

sanskrit: gā̱thapa̍tim me̱dhapa̍tiṁ ru̱draṁ jalā̍ṣabheṣajam | tac cha̱ṁyoḥ su̱mnam ī̍mahe ||
english: Of Rudra, lord of songs, lord of sacrifice, healer with cooling balm — we implore that gracious benevolence and peace.

sanskrit: yaḥ śu̱kra i̍va̱ sūryo̱ hira̍ṇyam iva̱ roca̍te | śreṣṭho̍ de̱vānā̱ṁ vasu̍ḥ ||
english: He who shines bright as the blazing sun, who gleams like gold — he is the best treasure among the gods.

sanskrit: śaṁ na̍ḥ kara̱ty arva̍te su̱gam me̱ṣāya̍ me̱ṣye̍ | nṛbhyo̱ nāri̍bhyo̱ gave̍ ||
english: He grants well-being to our horse, easy passage to ram and ewe, to our men, our women, and our cow.

sanskrit: a̱sme so̍ma̱ śriya̱m adhi̱ ni dhe̍hi śa̱tasya̍ nṛ̱ṇām | mahi̱ śrava̍s tuvinṛ̱mṇam ||
english: O Soma, bestow upon us splendor, upon a hundred men; great fame and mighty power.

sanskrit: mā na̍ḥ somapari̱bādho̱ mārā̍tayo juhuranta | ā na̍ indo̱ vāje̍ bhaja ||
english: May no oppressors hem us in around the Soma, may no hostilities lead us astray; O Indu, grant us a share in the prize.

sanskrit: yās te̍ pra̱jā a̱mṛta̍sya̱ para̍smi̱n dhāma̍nn ṛ̱tasya̍ | mū̱rdhā nābhā̍ soma vena ā̱bhūṣa̍ntīḥ soma vedaḥ ||
english: Those progeny of yours, O Soma — of the immortal one, in the further abode of ṛta, at the crown and navel, O Soma who are longed for — knowing those who adorn themselves, O Soma, you know them.

sanskrit: agne̱ viva̍svad u̱ṣasa̍ś ci̱traṁ rādho̍ amartya | ā dā̱śuṣe̍ jātavedo vahā̱ tvam a̱dyā de̱vām̐ u̍ṣa̱rbudha̍ḥ ||
english: O Agni, bright like the shining Dawn, O immortal Jātavedas, bring today the wondrous bounty to the worshipper; bring hither the gods who wake at dawn.

sanskrit: juṣṭo̱ hi dū̱to asi̍ havya̱vāha̱no 'gne̍ ra̱thīr a̍dhva̱rāṇā̍m | sa̱jūr a̱śvibhyā̍m u̱ṣasā̍ su̱vīrya̍m a̱sme dhe̍hi̱ śravo̍ bṛ̱hat ||
english: For you are the beloved messenger, O Agni, the carrier of oblations, the charioteer of sacrifices; in concert with the Aśvins and with Dawn bestow upon us great renown and heroic strength.

sanskrit: a̱dyā dū̱taṁ vṛ̍ṇīmahe̱ vasu̍m a̱gnim pu̍rupri̱yam | dhū̱make̍tu̱m bhāṛ̍jīka̱ṁ vyu̍ṣṭiṣu ya̱jñānā̍m adhvara̱śriya̍m ||
english: Today we choose as messenger the good Agni, beloved of many, whose banner is smoke, who blazes bright, the glory of sacrifices at the breaking of dawn.

sanskrit: śreṣṭha̱ṁ yavi̍ṣṭha̱m ati̍thi̱ṁ svā̍huta̱ṁ juṣṭa̱ṁ janā̍ya dā̱śuṣe̍ | de̱vām̐ acchā̱ yāta̍ve jā̱tave̍dasam a̱gnim ī̍ḻe̱ vyu̍ṣṭiṣu ||
english: The best and youngest, the guest, well-offered, beloved by the giving folk — I praise Agni Jātavedas, to travel toward the gods at the breaking of dawn.

sanskrit: sta̱vi̱ṣyāmi̱ tvām a̱haṁ viśva̍syāmṛta bhojana | agne̍ trā̱tāra̍m a̱mṛta̍m miyedhya̱ yaji̍ṣṭhaṁ havyavāhana ||
english: I shall praise you, O immortal enjoyer of all; O Agni, immortal protector, worthy of worship, most deserving of the sacrifice, O carrier of oblations.

sanskrit: su̱śaṁso̍ bodhi gṛṇa̱te ya̍viṣṭhya̱ madhu̍jihva̱ḥ svā̍hutaḥ | praska̍ṇvasya prati̱rann āyu̍r jī̱vase̍ nama̱syā daivya̱ṁ jana̍m ||
english: Be well-praised to the singer, O youngest, honey-tongued, well-fueled; prolonging the life of Praskaṇva so that he may live, be reverenced by the divine folk.

sanskrit: hotā̍raṁ vi̱śvave̍dasa̱ṁ saṁ hi tvā̱ viśa̍ i̱ndhate̍ | sa ā va̍ha puruhūta̱ prace̍ta̱so 'gne̍ de̱vām̐ i̱ha dra̱vat ||
english: For the peoples kindle you, all-knowing hotar; so bring them here swiftly, O Agni, far-sighted one, much-invoked, bring the gods hither.

sanskrit: sa̱vi̱tāra̍m u̱ṣasa̍m a̱śvinā̱ bhaga̍m a̱gniṁ vyu̍ṣṭiṣu̱ kṣapa̍ḥ | kaṇvā̍sas tvā su̱taso̍māsa indhate havya̱vāha̍ṁ svadhvara ||
english: Savitṛ, Dawn, the Aśvins, Bhaga — the Kaṇvas with pressed Soma kindle you, O Agni, at the night's breaking, O carrier of oblations, you who render the sacrifice auspicious.

sanskrit: pati̱r hy a̍dhva̱rāṇā̱m agne̍ dū̱to vi̱śām asi̍ | u̱ṣa̱rbudha̱ ā va̍ha̱ soma̍pītaye de̱vām̐ a̱dya sva̱rdṛśa̍ḥ ||
english: For you are the lord of sacrifices, O Agni, the messenger of the peoples; O you who wake at dawn, bring hither today the heaven-beholding gods for the drinking of Soma.

sanskrit: agne̱ pūrvā̱ anū̱ṣaso̍ vibhāvaso dī̱detha̍ vi̱śvada̍rśataḥ | asi̱ grāme̍ṣv avi̱tā pu̱rohi̱to 'si̍ ya̱jñeṣu̱ mānu̍ṣaḥ ||
english: O Agni, O radiant one, you have shone through the dawns of old, seen by all; you are the protector and purohita in the villages, you are the human priest at the sacrifices.

sanskrit: ni tvā̍ ya̱jñasya̱ sādha̍na̱m agne̱ hotā̍ram ṛ̱tvija̍m | ma̱nu̱ṣvad de̍va dhīmahi̱ prace̍tasaṁ jī̱raṁ dū̱tam ama̍rtyam ||
english: We set you in place, O Agni, as the accomplisher of the sacrifice, the hotar, the seasonal priest — O far-sighted, swift, immortal messenger, as Manu did, O god.

sanskrit: yad de̱vānā̍m mitramahaḥ pu̱rohi̱to 'nta̍ro̱ yāsi̍ dū̱tya̍m | sindho̍r iva̱ prasva̍nitāsa ū̱rmayo̱ 'gner bhrā̍jante a̱rcaya̍ḥ ||
english: When, O Agni, revered by Mitra's friends, you go on your mission as purohita among the gods, your flames blaze bright like the roaring waves of a river.

sanskrit: śru̱dhi śru̍tkarṇa̱ vahni̍bhir de̱vair a̍gne sa̱yāva̍bhiḥ | ā sī̍dantu ba̱rhiṣi̍ mi̱tro a̍rya̱mā prā̍ta̱ryāvā̍ṇo adhva̱ram ||
english: Hear, O Agni, you of the listening ear, together with the god-bearers, your companions; may Mitra and Aryamā, who journey in the morning, sit down upon the barhis at the sacrifice.

sanskrit: śṛ̱ṇvantu̱ stoma̍m ma̱ruta̍ḥ su̱dāna̍vo 'gniji̱hvā ṛ̍tā̱vṛdha̍ḥ | piba̍tu̱ soma̱ṁ varu̍ṇo dhṛ̱tavra̍to̱ 'śvibhyā̍m u̱ṣasā̍ sa̱jūḥ ||
english: May the Maruts, bounteous ones, whose tongue is Agni, increasers of ṛta, hear the hymn; may Varuṇa of steadfast vow drink the Soma, together with the Aśvins and with Dawn.

sanskrit: tvam a̍gne̱ vasū̍m̐r i̱ha ru̱drām̐ ā̍di̱tyām̐ u̱ta | yajā̍ svadhva̱raṁ jana̱m manu̍jātaṁ ghṛta̱pruṣa̍m ||
english: O Agni, sacrifice here to the Vasus, the Rudras, and the Ādityas; sacrifice to the people born of Manu, the Manu-born folk who sprinkle ghee, making the rite auspicious.

sanskrit: śru̱ṣṭī̱vāno̱ hi dā̱śuṣe̍ de̱vā a̍gne̱ vice̍tasaḥ | tān ro̍hidaśva girvaṇa̱s traya̍striṁśata̱m ā va̍ha ||
english: For the gods, O Agni, are prompt to heed the worshipper, they are discerning; bring them here, O you praised with songs, O you whose horses are red — all thirty-three.

sanskrit: pri̱ya̱me̱dha̱vad a̍tri̱vaj jāta̍vedo virūpa̱vat | a̱ṅgi̱ra̱svan ma̍hivrata̱ praska̍ṇvasya śrudhī̱ hava̍m ||
english: As for Priyamedha, as for Atri, O Jātavedas, as for Virūpa, as for the Aṅgirases — O you of great vows, hear the call of Praskaṇva.

sanskrit: mahi̍kerava ū̱taye̍ pri̱yame̍dhā ahūṣata | rāja̍ntam adhva̱rāṇā̍m a̱gniṁ śu̱kreṇa̍ śo̱ciṣā̍ ||
english: The Priyamedhas called on the great-horned one for aid — Agni, the king of sacrifices, blazing with brilliant splendor.

sanskrit: ghṛtā̍havana santye̱mā u̱ ṣu śru̍dhī̱ gira̍ḥ | yābhi̱ḥ kaṇva̍sya sū̱navo̱ hava̍nte̱ 'va̍se tvā ||
english: O you who are invoked with ghee, these words are real and true — hear them; with these songs the sons of Kaṇva call upon you for protection.

sanskrit: tvāṁ ci̍traśravastama̱ hava̍nte vi̱kṣu ja̱ntava̍ḥ | śo̱ciṣke̍śam purupri̱yāgne̍ ha̱vyāya̱ voḻha̍ve ||
english: You, of most wondrous fame, O Agni, O hair of flame, O most beloved — the beings among the clans call upon you to carry their oblations.

sanskrit: ni tvā̱ hotā̍ram ṛ̱tvija̍ṁ dadhi̱re va̍su̱vitta̍mam | śrutka̍rṇaṁ sa̱pratha̍stama̱ṁ viprā̍ agne̱ divi̍ṣṭiṣu ||
english: The inspired seers have set you in place, O Agni, as hotar and seasonal priest, most rich in goods, of listening ear, most widely famed, at the celestial rites.

sanskrit: ā tvā̱ viprā̍ acucyavuḥ su̱taso̍mā a̱bhi praya̍ḥ | bṛ̱had bhā bibhra̍to ha̱vir agne̱ martā̍ya dā̱śuṣe̍ ||
english: The inspired poets with pressed Soma have stirred you toward the offering; bearing a great light, O Agni, bring the oblation to the mortal worshipper.

sanskrit: prā̱ta̱ryāvṇa̍ḥ sahaskṛta soma̱peyā̍ya santya | i̱hādya daivya̱ṁ jana̍m ba̱rhir ā sā̍dayā vaso ||
english: O powerful one, true one, you who travel in the morning — for the drinking of Soma, seat the divine company here today upon the sacred grass, O Vasu.

sanskrit: a̱rvāñca̱ṁ daivya̱ṁ jana̱m agne̱ yakṣva̱ sahū̍tibhiḥ | a̱yaṁ soma̍ḥ sudānava̱s tam pā̍ta ti̱roa̍hnyam ||
english: O Agni, honor with joined invocations the divine company that faces toward us; this Soma is present, O bounteous ones — drink it throughout the day.

sanskrit: e̱ṣo u̱ṣā apū̍rvyā̱ vy u̍cchati pri̱yā di̱vaḥ | stu̱ṣe vā̍m aśvinā bṛ̱hat ||
english: This unprecedented Dawn is shining forth, beloved of the sky; I praise you two, O Aśvins, with a great hymn.

sanskrit: yā da̱srā sindhu̍mātarā mano̱tarā̍ rayī̱ṇām | dhi̱yā de̱vā va̍su̱vidā̍ ||
english: You two wondrous ones whose mother is the river, who fly swifter than thought among riches — divine ones who find wealth through insight.

sanskrit: va̱cyante̍ vāṁ kaku̱hāso̍ jū̱rṇāyā̱m adhi̍ vi̱ṣṭapi̍ | yad vā̱ṁ ratho̱ vibhi̱ṣ patā̍t ||
english: Your praises resound, O mighty ones, in the heaven on high in the ancient world; when your chariot flies with its wings abroad.

sanskrit: ha̱viṣā̍ jā̱ro a̱pām pipa̍rti̱ papu̍rir narā | pi̱tā kuṭa̍sya carṣa̱ṇiḥ ||
english: The lover of the waters, who has drunk deep, fills with oblation, O heroes — the father of the kuṭa, the observer of men.

sanskrit: ā̱dā̱ro vā̍m matī̱nāṁ nāsa̍tyā matavacasā | pā̱taṁ soma̍sya dhṛṣṇu̱yā ||
english: Ready is our reception of your thoughts, O Nāsatyās, you who speak with inspired words; drink the Soma boldly.

sanskrit: yā na̱ḥ pīpa̍rad aśvinā̱ jyoti̍ṣmatī̱ tama̍s ti̱raḥ | tām a̱sme rā̍sāthā̱m iṣa̍m ||
english: That which shall carry us across the darkness, O Aśvins, that light-bearing gift — bestow that refreshment upon us.

sanskrit: ā no̍ nā̱vā ma̍tī̱nāṁ yā̱tam pā̱rāya̱ ganta̍ve | yu̱ñjāthā̍m aśvinā̱ ratha̍m ||
english: Come to us on the ship of thought, to travel to the far shore; yoke your chariot, O Aśvins.

sanskrit: a̱ritra̍ṁ vāṁ di̱vas pṛ̱thu tī̱rthe sindhū̍nā̱ṁ ratha̍ḥ | dhi̱yā yu̍yujra̱ inda̍vaḥ ||
english: Your rudder is the broad sky; your chariot stands at the ford of rivers; the Soma drops have been yoked by thought.

sanskrit: di̱vas ka̍ṇvāsa̱ inda̍vo̱ vasu̱ sindhū̍nām pa̱de | svaṁ va̱vriṁ kuha̍ dhitsathaḥ ||
english: The Kaṇvan Soma drops from heaven, the wealth at the place of the rivers — where do you two wish to deposit your own veil?

sanskrit: abhū̍d u̱ bhā u̍ a̱ṁśave̱ hira̍ṇya̱m prati̱ sūrya̍ḥ ||
english: There arose a radiance for the Soma stalk; golden, the Sun turned toward it, and dark-tongued fire perceived it clearly.

sanskrit: abhū̍d u pā̱ram eta̍ve̱ panthā̍ ṛ̱tasya̍ sādhu̱yā | ada̍rśi̱ vi sru̱tir di̱vaḥ ||
english: There arose a path to cross over, on the right course of ṛta; the flowing path of heaven was clearly seen.

sanskrit: tat-ta̱d id a̱śvino̱r avo̍ jari̱tā prati̍ bhūṣati | made̱ soma̍sya̱ pipra̍toḥ ||
english: That — that very aid of the Aśvins does the singer adorn, in the exhilaration of the flowing Soma.

sanskrit: vā̱va̱sā̱nā vi̱vasva̍ti̱ soma̍sya pī̱tyā gi̱rā | ma̱nu̱ṣvac cha̍mbhū̱ ā ga̍tam ||
english: Desiring, you two radiant ones — come, as Manu did, with the drinking of Soma and with the song, you two who bring well-being.

sanskrit: yu̱vor u̱ṣā anu̱ śriya̱m pari̍jmanor u̱pāca̍rat | ṛ̱tā va̍natho a̱ktubhi̍ḥ ||
english: Dawn attended upon the glory of you two who circle round; you two win through ṛta, with the night-beams.

sanskrit: u̱bhā pi̍batam aśvino̱bhā na̱ḥ śarma̍ yacchatam | a̱vi̱dri̱yābhi̍r ū̱tibhi̍ḥ ||
english: Both of you drink; both of you grant us shelter, O Aśvins, with aids that drive away what is alien.

sanskrit: a̱yaṁ vā̱m madhu̍mattamaḥ su̱taḥ soma̍ ṛtāvṛdhā | tam a̍śvinā pibataṁ ti̱roa̍hnyaṁ dha̱ttaṁ ratnā̍ni dā̱śuṣe̍ ||
english: This sweetest pressed Soma, O increasers of ṛta — drink of it throughout the day, O Aśvins, and bestow jewels upon the worshipper.

sanskrit: tri̱va̱ndhu̱reṇa̍ tri̱vṛtā̍ su̱peśa̍sā̱ rathe̱nā yā̍tam aśvinā | kaṇvā̍so vā̱m brahma̍ kṛṇvanty adhva̱re teṣā̱ṁ su śṛ̍ṇuta̱ṁ hava̍m ||
english: Come, O Aśvins, on the triple-yoked, triple-twisted, beautiful chariot; the Kaṇvas fashion the sacred prayer for you at the sacrifice — hear well their call.

sanskrit: aśvi̍nā̱ madhu̍mattamam pā̱taṁ soma̍m ṛtāvṛdhā | athā̱dya da̍srā̱ vasu̱ bibhra̍tā̱ rathe̍ dā̱śvāṁsa̱m upa̍ gacchatam ||
english: O Aśvins, O increasers of ṛta, drink the sweetest Soma; and then today, O wondrous ones, bearing wealth in your chariot, approach the worshipping man.

sanskrit: tri̱ṣa̱dha̱sthe ba̱rhiṣi̍ viśvavedasā̱ madhvā̍ ya̱jñam mi̍mikṣatam | kaṇvā̍so vāṁ su̱taso̍mā a̱bhidya̍vo yu̱vāṁ ha̍vante aśvinā ||
english: O all-knowing ones, sprinkle the sacrifice with sweetness at the three-seated sacred grass; the Kaṇvas with pressed Soma, the brilliant ones, call upon you two, O Aśvins.

sanskrit: yābhi̱ḥ kaṇva̍m a̱bhiṣṭi̍bhi̱ḥ prāva̍taṁ yu̱vam a̍śvinā | tābhi̱ḥ ṣv a1̱̍smām̐ a̍vataṁ śubhas patī pā̱taṁ soma̍m ṛtāvṛdhā ||
english: With those helps with which you two, O Aśvins, formerly aided Kaṇva, with those very same aids protect us now, O lords of beauty; drink the Soma, O increasers of ṛta.

sanskrit: su̱dāse̍ dasrā̱ vasu̱ bibhra̍tā̱ rathe̱ pṛkṣo̍ vahatam aśvinā | ra̱yiṁ sa̍mu̱drād u̱ta vā̍ di̱vas pary a̱sme dha̍ttam puru̱spṛha̍m ||
english: O wondrous Aśvins, bearing wealth in your chariot, bring nourishment to Sudās; place upon us from the ocean or from heaven riches much to be coveted.

sanskrit: yan nā̍satyā parā̱vati̱ yad vā̱ stho adhi̍ tu̱rvaśe̍ | ato̱ rathe̍na su̱vṛtā̍ na̱ ā ga̍taṁ sā̱kaṁ sūrya̍sya ra̱śmibhi̍ḥ ||
english: Whether you two Nāsatyās are in the far distance, or whether you abide with Turvaśa — from there come to us on your well-rolling chariot, together with the rays of the sun.

sanskrit: a̱rvāñcā̍ vā̱ṁ sapta̍yo 'dhvara̱śriyo̱ vaha̍ntu̱ sava̱ned upa̍ | iṣa̍m pṛ̱ñcantā̍ su̱kṛte̍ su̱dāna̍va̱ ā ba̱rhiḥ sī̍dataṁ narā ||
english: May your horses, glorious at the sacrifice, bear you hitherward swiftly; mixing refreshment for the well-doer, O bounteous ones, sit down upon the sacred grass, O heroes.

sanskrit: tena̍ nāsa̱tyā ga̍ta̱ṁ rathe̍na̱ sūrya̍tvacā | yena̱ śaśva̍d ū̱hathu̍r dā̱śuṣe̱ vasu̱ madhva̱ḥ soma̍sya pī̱taye̍ ||
english: Come, O Nāsatyās, on that sun-skinned chariot with which you have always carried goods to the worshipper, for the drinking of the sweet Soma.

sanskrit: u̱kthebhi̍r a̱rvāg ava̍se purū̱vasū̍ a̱rkaiś ca̱ ni hva̍yāmahe | śaśva̱t kaṇvā̍nā̱ṁ sada̍si pri̱ye hi ka̱ṁ soma̍m pa̱pathu̍r aśvinā ||
english: With recitations and with songs we call upon you two, rich in many goods, to come hither for our protection; for, O Aśvins, you have ever drunk Soma joyfully in the dear assembly of the Kaṇvas.

sanskrit: sa̱ha vā̱mena̍ na uṣo̱ vy u̍cchā duhitar divaḥ | sa̱ha dyu̱mnena̍ bṛha̱tā vi̍bhāvari rā̱yā de̍vi̱ dāsva̍tī ||
english: Shine forth for us with wealth, O Dawn, O daughter of the sky; with great splendor, O radiant one — grant us riches, O goddess.

sanskrit: aśvā̍vatī̱r goma̍tīr viśvasu̱vido̱ bhūri̍ cyavanta̱ vasta̍ve | ud ī̍raya̱ prati̍ mā sū̱nṛtā̍ uṣa̱ś coda̱ rādho̍ ma̱ghonā̍m ||
english: Rich in horses, rich in cows, bearing all gifts — they stir forth in abundance to awaken; rouse toward me the true and joyful words, O Dawn, and urge on the bounty of the liberal ones.

sanskrit: u̱vāso̱ṣā u̱cchāc ca̱ nu de̱vī jī̱rā rathā̍nām | ye a̍syā ā̱cara̍ṇeṣu dadhri̱re sa̍mu̱dre na śra̍va̱syava̍ḥ ||
english: Dawn has shone and will shine yet again, the goddess who is swift with chariots; those who have been set in her courses, like men who covet fame in the sea.

sanskrit: uṣo̱ ye te̱ pra yāme̍ṣu yu̱ñjate̱ mano̍ dā̱nāya̍ sū̱raya̍ḥ ||
english: O Dawn, those wise men who, at your departing journeys, yoke their minds toward giving — here among these, Kaṇva, most Kaṇva-like of them, proclaims the name of heroes.

sanskrit: ā ghā̱ yoṣe̍va sū̱nary u̱ṣā yā̍ti prabhuñja̱tī | ja̱raya̍ntī̱ vṛja̍nam pa̱dvad ī̍yata̱ ut pā̍tayati pa̱kṣiṇa̍ḥ ||
english: Dawn comes like a lovely woman, gracious, consuming all before her; wearing away the settled folk she moves on foot, and sends the birds flying up.

sanskrit: vi yā sṛ̱jati̱ sama̍na̱ṁ vy a1̱̍rthina̍ḥ pa̱daṁ na ve̱ty oda̍tī | vayo̱ naki̍ṣ ṭe papti̱vāṁsa̍ āsate̱ vyu̍ṣṭau vājinīvati ||
english: She who sends forth the assembly and the seekers of goals, not knowing rest as she swells up — no bird sits still at your shining, O Dawn who bear the prize.

sanskrit: e̱ṣāyu̍kta parā̱vata̱ḥ sūrya̍syo̱daya̍nā̱d adhi̍ | śa̱taṁ rathe̍bhiḥ su̱bhago̱ṣā i̱yaṁ vi yā̍ty a̱bhi mānu̍ṣān ||
english: This auspicious Dawn has yoked her team from the far distance, above the rising place of the Sun; with a hundred chariots she moves forth across toward humankind.

sanskrit: viśva̍m asyā nānāma̱ cakṣa̍se̱ jaga̱j jyoti̍ṣ kṛṇoti sū̱narī̍ | apa̱ dveṣo̍ ma̱ghonī̍ duhi̱tā di̱va u̱ṣā u̍ccha̱d apa̱ sridha̍ḥ ||
english: The whole world bows to her that it may see; the gracious one makes the moving world light; the daughter of heaven, the bounteous Dawn, has shone forth, driving away hatred and foes.

sanskrit: uṣa̱ ā bhā̍hi bhā̱nunā̍ ca̱ndreṇa̍ duhitar divaḥ | ā̱vaha̍ntī̱ bhūry a̱smabhya̱ṁ saubha̍gaṁ vyu̱cchantī̱ divi̍ṣṭiṣu ||
english: O Dawn, shine forth with your bright and brilliant radiance, O daughter of the sky; bringing great good fortune to us, shining in your celestial courses.

sanskrit: viśva̍sya̱ hi prāṇa̍na̱ṁ jīva̍na̱ṁ tve vi yad u̱cchasi̍ sūnari | sā no̱ rathe̍na bṛha̱tā vi̍bhāvari śru̱dhi ci̍trāmaghe̱ hava̍m ||
english: For when you shine forth, O gracious one, the breath and life of all the world is in you; so hear our call on your great radiant chariot, O wondrous-wealthy one.

sanskrit: uṣo̱ vāja̱ṁ hi vaṁsva̱ yaś ci̱tro mānu̍ṣe̱ jane̍ | tenā va̍ha su̱kṛto̍ adhva̱rām̐ upa̱ ye tvā̍ gṛ̱ṇanti̱ vahna̍yaḥ ||
english: O Dawn, win the prize that is conspicuous among the human folk; with that bring the good-doers toward the rites, those who praise you, those who carry the offering.

sanskrit: viśvā̍n de̱vām̐ ā va̍ha̱ soma̍pītaye̱ 'ntari̍kṣād uṣa̱s tvam | sāsmāsu̍ dhā̱ goma̱d aśvā̍vad u̱kthya1̱̍m uṣo̱ vāja̍ṁ su̱vīrya̍m ||
english: Bring all the gods from the mid-air for the drinking of Soma, O Dawn; and place upon us that which is worthy of hymns — wealth in cows and horses, O Dawn, and heroic strength.

sanskrit: yasyā̱ ruśa̍nto a̱rcaya̱ḥ prati̍ bha̱drā adṛ̍kṣata | sā no̍ ra̱yiṁ vi̱śvavā̍raṁ su̱peśa̍sam u̱ṣā da̍dātu̱ sugmya̍m ||
english: She whose gleaming, propitious rays have been seen coming forward — may that Dawn grant us wealth of all desirable things, of beautiful form, easy to obtain.

sanskrit: ye ci̱d dhi tvām ṛṣa̍ya̱ḥ pūrva̍ ū̱taye̍ juhū̱re 'va̍se mahi | sā na̱ḥ stomā̍m̐ a̱bhi gṛ̍ṇīhi̱ rādha̱soṣa̍ḥ śu̱kreṇa̍ śo̱ciṣā̍ ||
english: Even the ancient seers who called upon you, O great one, for aid and protection — answer our hymns, O Dawn, and grant your bounty with your brilliant splendor.

sanskrit: uṣo̱ yad a̱dya bhā̱nunā̱ vi dvārā̍v ṛ̱ṇavo̍ di̱vaḥ | pra no̍ yacchatād avṛ̱kam pṛ̱thu ccha̱rdiḥ pra de̍vi̱ goma̍tī̱r iṣa̍ḥ ||
english: O Dawn, when today with your radiance you throw open the two doors of heaven, grant us a broad and wolf-free shelter, O goddess, and food rich in cattle.

sanskrit: saṁ no̍ rā̱yā bṛ̍ha̱tā vi̱śvape̍śasā mimi̱kṣvā sam iḻā̍bhi̱r ā | saṁ dyu̱mnena̍ viśva̱turo̍ṣo mahi̱ saṁ vājai̍r vājinīvati ||
english: Blend for us great wealth of all beautiful forms, blend for us with refreshments, O Dawn; blend for us, O Dawn who shines in all directions, with great splendor; and with prizes, O you who bear the prize.

sanskrit: uṣo̍ bha̱drebhi̱r ā ga̍hi di̱vaś ci̍d roca̱nād adhi̍ | vaha̍ntv aru̱ṇapsa̍va̱ upa̍ tvā so̱mino̍ gṛ̱ham ||
english: Come, O Dawn, with auspicious gifts, from above the bright shining of the sky; may the reddish-tinged steeds carry those who press Soma toward your dwelling.

sanskrit: su̱peśa̍saṁ su̱khaṁ ratha̱ṁ yam a̱dhyasthā̍ uṣa̱s tvam | tenā̍ su̱śrava̍sa̱ṁ jana̱m prāvā̱dya du̍hitar divaḥ ||
english: The beautiful, pleasant chariot upon which you have mounted, O Dawn — with that protect today the folk of great renown, O daughter of the sky.

sanskrit: vaya̍ś cit te pata̱triṇo̍ dvi̱pac catu̍ṣpad arjuni | uṣa̱ḥ prāra̍nn ṛ̱tūm̐r anu̍ di̱vo ante̍bhya̱s pari̍ ||
english: Even the birds that have wings, O bright Dawn, two-footed and four-footed — they all start forth at your coming, following the seasons from the ends of heaven.

sanskrit: vyu̱cchantī̱ hi ra̱śmibhi̱r viśva̍m ā̱bhāsi̍ roca̱nam ||
english: Shining forth with your rays, you illumine all the bright world; desiring wealth, the Kaṇvas have called upon you, O Dawn, with songs.

sanskrit: ud u̱ tyaṁ jā̱tave̍dasaṁ de̱vaṁ va̍hanti ke̱tava̍ḥ | dṛ̱śe viśvā̍ya̱ sūrya̍m ||
english: The bright rays bear aloft that god, Jātavedas, so that all may see — they bear up Sūrya.

sanskrit: apa̱ tye tā̱yavo̍ yathā̱ nakṣa̍trā yanty a̱ktubhi̍ḥ | sūrā̍ya vi̱śvaca̍kṣase ||
english: Like thieves the stars slink away with the night, before Sūrya the all-seeing one.

sanskrit: adṛ̍śram asya ke̱tavo̱ vi ra̱śmayo̱ janā̱m̐ anu̍ | bhrāja̍nto a̱gnayo̍ yathā ||
english: His bright rays have been seen, spreading out among the peoples, blazing like fires.

sanskrit: ta̱raṇi̍r vi̱śvada̍rśato jyoti̱ṣkṛd a̍si sūrya | viśva̱m ā bhā̍si roca̱nam ||
english: You are swift, seen by all, O Sūrya, maker of light; you shine upon the entire bright world.

sanskrit: pra̱tyaṅ de̱vānā̱ṁ viśa̍ḥ pra̱tyaṅṅ ud e̍ṣi̱ mānu̍ṣān | pra̱tyaṅ viśva̱ṁ sva̍r dṛ̱śe ||
english: You rise facing toward the peoples of the gods, facing toward mankind, facing toward all the world to see the sun-light.

sanskrit: yenā̍ pāvaka̱ cakṣa̍sā bhura̱ṇyanta̱ṁ janā̱m̐ anu̍ | tvaṁ va̍ruṇa̱ paśya̍si ||
english: With that pure eye of yours, as it moves busily among the peoples, you, Varuṇa, look upon them.

sanskrit: vi dyām e̍ṣi̱ raja̍s pṛ̱thv ahā̱ mimā̍no a̱ktubhi̍ḥ | paśya̱ñ janmā̍ni sūrya ||
english: You traverse the broad, wide expanse of the sky, measuring out the days by nights, O Sūrya, looking upon all creatures.

sanskrit: sa̱pta tvā̍ ha̱rito̱ rathe̱ vaha̍nti deva sūrya | śo̱ciṣke̍śaṁ vicakṣaṇa ||
english: Seven bay mares carry you in your chariot, O god Sūrya, O flame-haired, far-sighted one.

sanskrit: ayu̍kta sa̱pta śu̱ndhyuva̱ḥ sūro̱ ratha̍sya na̱ptya̍ḥ | tābhi̍r yāti̱ svayu̍ktibhiḥ ||
english: The Sun has yoked the seven bright mares, the daughters of his chariot; with these he travels, self-yoked.

sanskrit: ud va̱yaṁ tama̍sa̱s pari̱ jyoti̱ṣ paśya̍nta̱ utta̍ram | de̱vaṁ de̍va̱trā sūrya̱m aga̍nma̱ jyoti̍r utta̱mam ||
english: Rising up out of the darkness, beholding the higher light, we have gone to Sūrya, the god among the gods — to the highest light.

sanskrit: u̱dyann a̱dya mi̍tramaha ā̱roha̱nn utta̍rā̱ṁ diva̍m | hṛ̱dro̱gam mama̍ sūrya hari̱māṇa̍ṁ ca nāśaya ||
english: Rising today, O you revered by Mitra, mounting the higher sky — O Sūrya, destroy my heart-sickness and my jaundice.

sanskrit: śuke̍ṣu me hari̱māṇa̍ṁ ropa̱ṇākā̍su dadhmasi | atho̍ hāridra̱veṣu̍ me hari̱māṇa̱ṁ ni da̍dhmasi ||
english: Into the parrots and the yellow-tinged mynah birds we blow off my jaundice; and into the haritāla-yellow plants we press down my jaundice.

sanskrit: ud a̍gād a̱yam ā̍di̱tyo viśve̍na̱ saha̍sā sa̱ha | dvi̱ṣanta̱m mahya̍ṁ ra̱ndhaya̱n mo a̱haṁ dvi̍ṣa̱te ra̍dham ||
english: This Āditya has risen, with all his might; may he subdue my enemy for me — let me not be subject to him who hates me.
